note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet Bratu、内点31/63。検証する離散fold anchorの下.1/.01/.001に固定し、下枝状態を用います。λ文字列は一度binary64へ変換し、その正確な値を高精度参照へ渡します。 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference One-dimensional Dirichlet Bratu with 31/63 interior nodes. Fixed gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor use lower-branch states. Each lambda string is converted once to binary64 and that exact value is passed to the high-precision reference. The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

name.en: Independent dense sensitivities and matrix-free VJPs for distributed Bratu coefficients

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet、63内点。a(x)=2+Bθは8/16/32個の線形hat制御で、主固定例は1.7≤a≤2.3。端点係数は零Dirichlet状態と異なり固定零にしません。 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet problem with 63 interior nodes. The coefficient a(x)=2+Btheta uses 8/16/32 linear-hat controls and stays between 1.7 and 2.3 in the fixed main cases. Endpoint coefficient controls are not zeroed like state Dirichlet values. Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.
